correctness.rationale: Using the exterior-degree-1--3 free model, projection of a square-zero U to V has rank at most one; its W intersection lies in the kernel of wedge by its projected line. This constructs and exhausts the two displayed ideal families, proves maximality and idealhood, and determines orbit/intersection types. Exact dimensions yield the formula for all r>=3 and odd prime powers q. Full 925771-subspace enumeration in rank 3 over F_3 found exactly 40; every candidate passed idealhood. Rank-four predicted 1081 candidates over F_3 also passed direct checks. The general theorem depends on the proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: Maximal abelian subalgebras form a natural extremal stratum of the free nonassociative algebra. This classification determines all of them for every rank r>=3, proves unexpectedly that each is an ideal, gives their automorphism orbits, two dimensions, pairwise intersection pattern, and an exact polynomial/exponential count over all odd finite fields. These are useful structural invariants beyond the earlier construction itself; the theorem is not merely a tiny finite-field recomputation.
